_about: Textbook JLPT level for everyday words that Waller's lists place oddly (greetings sit in his N3-N2 lists, so beginners saw こんにちは as N3; さん and と sat in N1). Keyed by the headword exactly as the app shows it; only unambiguous set phrases and Minna no Nihongo 1-25 / Genki I words. Used by scripts/content/build.ts (jlptLevel); levels only ever get easier.
